page.overview:
Who is Baby Toad?

Baby Toad is a character who made a cameo in The Super Mario Galaxy Movie.

As a toddler, Baby Toad wears an only wears his diaper pants just like Mario and Luigi. He also holds a light blue pacifier in his mouth.
